It's one thing for a robot to perform a single action. It's another to complete an entire task on its own.  

At AGIBOT Innovation Day 2026, AGIBOT A3 Ultra demonstrated autonomous cross-floor navigation and extended autonomous room tidying, showcasing its ability to navigate complex indoor environments, recognize surroundings, make decisions, and carry out tasks over time with minimal human intervention.  

These demos go beyond individual movements, showing how humanoid robots are moving toward more autonomous and sustained work in real-world environments. 

 #AGIBOT #AGIBOTInnovationDay #Worken #EmbodiedAI

110 humanoid robots. One synchronized performance. A GUINNESS WORLD RECORDS.  

110 AGIBOT A3 humanoid robots danced in unison, setting the GUINNESS WORLD RECORDS for the most humanoid robots dancing simultaneously.  

Beyond the spectacular light show, the performance showcased the coordination capabilities behind large-scale robot deployments. Powered by UWB centimeter-level positioning and the LinkBots multi-robot control system, all 110 robots performed in precise synchronization, completing the challenge without a single error.  

A new milestone in multi-robot coordination — where engineering precision meets the art of motion.
